t: You're at Northampton Square, a green town square in the corner of Clerkenwell that projects into Finsbury. It sits between Goswell Road and St John Street. Most of the buildings facing it belong to City St George's, University of London, and there's a very broad pedestrian walkway on the north-west side. The painter and etcher James Clarke Hook was born here. He lived from 1819 to 1907, and he painted marine, genre and historical scenes, as well as landscapes.
